newsitem.title: USA: U.S. likely to appoint Ruckelshaus as fish envoy.
newsitem.headline: U.S. likely to appoint Ruckelshaus as fish envoy.

text.p: The United States is likely to appoint former government official William Ruckelshaus as its special troubleshooter in its dispute with Canada over the Pacific salmon catch, a government official said on Thursday.
The official said an announcement would probably be made soon on the appointment of Ruckelshaus as the "eminent person" whose job would be to reinvigorate negotiations which stalled last month.
The two countries agreed on Wednesday to appoint special envoys to try to restart talks on the dispute. The envoys will report directly to President Bill Clinton and Prime Minister Jean Chretien.
Ruckelshaus has been head of the Environmental Protection Agency, an acting director of the FBI and deputy attorney-general.
